name: Solstice Spa Retreat
description: Day spa and wellness hotel in the fictional village of Elmsworth.

items.title: Spa day packages
items.content: The Unwind day costs $135 with 2 treatments; the Twilight package runs 17:05 to 21:25 for $98. Brochure SSR-PKG-2.

items.title: Pool safety rules
items.content: Under-16s may use the pool only from 09:10 to 11:40 with an adult; the sauna is adults only. Sign SSR-POOL-16.

items.title: Therapist scheduling
items.content: Therapists do at most 6 treatments a day with 15-minute breaks; bookings are managed by spa lead Noor Haddad. Rules SSR-THR-6.

items.title: Product commission
items.content: Therapists earn 11.5% commission on retail product sales above $400 a month. Scheme SSR-COM-115.

items.title: Towel laundry contract
items.content: Towels and robes are laundered by Elmsworth Laundry Services at $0.72 per item, collected daily; the contract ends 2027-08-31. Contract SSR-LND-0831.

items.title: Guest injury claim
items.content: A guest slipped on the steam room floor on 2026-08-04 and fractured her wrist; she is claiming $42,000 and our insurer, Holloway Assurance, expects to settle. Claim SSR-INJ-0804-H.
